channel.title: The Smithfield Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Smithfield Times (smithfieldtimes.com)

item.title: Good causes, y’all: Murder mystery shows net $1,000 for IW Ed Foundation, Dolly Parton library
item.description: Local theater troupe's murder mystery dinners fund $1,000 donations to the Isle of Wight Education Foundation and Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library.

item.title: Living Well, Together: The Power of Community at Church Square
item.description: Discover how Church Square, a 55+ community in Smithfield, is designed for connection, low-maintenance living, and everyday traditions that bring neighbors, friends, and family closer.

item.title: Town Council accepts $1.7M bid for Luter Sports Complex maintenance building
item.description: Smithfield's Town Council approved a $1.7M contract for a 3,800-square-foot maintenance building at Luter Sports Complex, coming in 15% under budget.

item.title: Hearing on Bridger’s Quarter commercial development set for March 24
item.description: Isle of Wight County's Planning Commission, on March 24, will hold a public hearing on a rezoning application for "Bridger’s Quarter," a 17.5-acre Benns Church Boulevard commercial development. It's one of several hearings on the agenda.

item.title: Editorial – Election promises proved cheap
item.description: Smithfield voters who backed reformers for transparency now see the Town Council approve a secretive $6.5 million land purchase, reviving Old Guard-style politics.

item.title: IWCS Superintendent Theo Cramer to step down June 30
item.description: Isle of Wight County Schools Superintendent Theo Cramer announced March 11 he would leave his post effective June 30.

item.title: Column – Times is a rarity with continuous local ownership
item.description: For more than 100 years, The Smithfield Times has remained in local hands, bucking the trend of newspaper chains.

item.title: Surry girls basketball team loses in state quarterfinals
item.description: After a turnaround from 0-23 record last season to 22-3 this year, Surry County High School's girls basketball season ended with a 49-38 Class 1 state quarterfinal loss at Essex.

item.title: Westside teacher charged with assaulting students
item.description: Westside Elementary teacher Catherine Sinclair, 67, is charged with assaulting four students during a tornado drill; a court hearing is set for March 17.

item.title: IW planners endorse land withdrawal, fence tied to broadband antenna array
item.description: Isle of Wight County's Planning Commission backed an agricultural/forestal land withdrawal request for an Old Stage Highway antenna array.
